'''Marie-Lise Chanin''' (Marie-Lise, Paule, Andrée Lory; born 26 September 1934 in [[Angers]]) is a French [[Geophysics|geophysicist]], aeronomist,<ref>{{cite web|title=Marie-Lise Chanin, précurseur de l'aéronomie|url=https://www.canalacademie.com/ida4457-Marie-Lise-Chanin-precurseur-de-l-aeronomie.html?page=article&id_article=4457|website=canalacademie.com| date=31 May 2009 }}</ref> director of research emerita at the [[French National Centre for Scientific Research|French National Centre for Scientific Research (CNRS)]], and author of works on the physics of the upper and middle atmosphere.

== Biography ==

=== Training and activities ===

Marie-Lise Lory had planned to study at the Beaux-Arts but is studied natural sciencesː she took a bachelor's degree in mathematics, then studied physics (quantum optics). On the advice of [[Alfred Kastler]] and [[Jean Brossel]]<ref>{{cite web|title=Marie-Lise Chanin|url=https://www.futura-sciences.com/sciences/personnalites/physique-marie-lise-chanin-271/|website=future-sciences.com}}</ref> she entered a laboratory created at the [[École normale supérieure (Paris)|École normale supérieure]], the Aeronomy Department. She gets married and has a son.

She obtained her ''licence de sciences'' in 1957, and her [[Doctorat ès sciences|doctorate ès sciences]] in 1965. In 1959, she had joined the CNRS as a research trainee, where she spent her entire professional career until her academic retirement in 2000, having become research director in 1986.

She was elected a corresponding member of the [[French Academy of Sciences]] on 26 March 1990, in the Sciences of the Universe section.<ref name=":0">{{Cite web|url=https://www.academie-sciences.fr/fr/Liste-des-membres-de-l-Academie-des-sciences-/-C/marie-lise-chanin.html|title=Marie-Lise Chanin|website=academie-sciences.fr|language=fr}}</ref> Throughout her career, she assumed many responsibilities<ref name=":0" /> member of the High Council of Meteorology, member of the Environment Committee of the French Academy of sciences (since 2005), French representative to the [[ICSU]] ([[International Council of Scientific Unions]]), member of the Scientific Council of the Centre for Unconventional Hydrocarbons, President of the French National Committee of [[Geodesy]] and [[Geophysics]] (1986–1990), among others.

She is also a member of the [[French Academy of Technologies]], the [[Académie de l'air et de l'espace|Académie de l'Air et de l'Espace]] and the [[Academia Europaea]].

== Awards ==

=== Decorations ===

Grand Officier of the [[Legion of Honour|Légion d'honneur]]. She was made a ''Chevalier'' on 26 September 1996, and was promoted to ''Officier'' on 31 December 2005,<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.legifrance.gouv.fr/affichTexte.do?cidTexte=JORFTEXT000000456787&dateTexte=&categorieLien=id|title=Décret du 31 décembre 2005 portant promotion et nomination|website=legifrance.gouv.fr|language=fr}}</ref> ''Commandeur'' on 29 March 2013,<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.legifrance.gouv.fr/affichTexte.do?cidTexte=JORFTEXT000027248222&dateTexte=&categorieLien=id|title=Décret du 29 mars 2013 portant promotion|website=legifrance.gouv.fr|language=fr}}</ref> before being raised to the dignity of ''Grand Officier'' on 30 December 2017.<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.legifrance.gouv.fr/affichTexte.do?cidTexte=JORFTEXT000036339819&dateTexte=&categorieLien=id|title=Décret du 30 décembre 2017 portant élévation aux dignités de grand'croix et de grand officier|website=legifrance.gouv.fr|language=fr}}</ref>

Grand Officier of the [[Ordre national du Mérite|Ordre National du Mérite]]. She received the distinction of ''Grand Officier'' on 30 December 2017.<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.legifrance.gouv.fr/affichTexte.do?cidTexte=JORFTEXT000021262347&dateTexte=&categorieLien=id|title=Décret du 13 novembre 2009 portant élévation aux dignités de grand'croix et de grand officier|website=legifrance.gouv.fr|language=fr}}</ref> She had been ''Commandeur'' since 28 November 2000.

=== Prizes ===
{{BLP unsourced section|date=July 2020}}
Her research has won several awards:

* Intercosmos Prize of the USSR Academy of Sciences (1974)
* [[CNRS Silver Medal|CNRS silver medal]] (1983)
* Deslandres Prize of the French Academy of sciences (1988)
* Prize of the Laboratories of the French Academy of sciences (1996)
* Vermeil Medal of the National Academy of Air and Space (1999)
* Prize of the [[International Academy of Astronautics]] (2006)
* [[NASA]] Group Achievement Award to UARS Team (2006)

== Scientific Works ==

=== Research topics ===

Marie-Lise Chanin has devoted her research to the physics of the upper and middle atmosphere, which brought her to an interest in the destruction of [[ozone]] in the stratosphere and climate change.<ref>Marie-Lise Chanin (L'humanité indique en préambule "L'Humanité Dimanche, dans le cadre d'un partenariat avec l'Académie des sciences, publie une nouvelle tribune donnant le point de vue d'un de ses membres sur de grandes thématiques scientifiques touchant à des enjeux de société."), « L'ozone, selon qu'il est stratosphérique ou troposphérique... », ''L'humanité dimanche'', 29 février 2016 (lire en ligne)</ref> She first studied the upper atmosphere: her thesis (directed by [[Jacques Blamont]]) was devoted to the measurement of the temperature of the upper atmosphere. She used the optical resonance of alkaline atoms emitted into the atmosphere by rockets and her measurements revealed the influence of solar activity and particle precipitation. She then developed methods for probing the atmosphere by [[laser]] or [[lidar]], which allow temperature measurements over distances of 10 to 100&nbsp;km. She highlighted the cooling of the stratosphere under the influence of [[greenhouse gas]]es. It clarified the role of the stratosphere on the climate and the influence of the air fleet on the environment.

=== Publications ===

She has published approximately 200 articles in peer-reviewed journals<ref>{{cite web |url=https://scholar.google.fr/scholar?hl=fr&as_sdt=0,5&q=Marie-Lise+Chanin&btnG= |title=Marie-Lise Chanin articles – Google Scholar |website=Google Scholar }}</ref> and has contributed to numerous reports.
